validation.detail: 由官方源码构建的 V1.0 出厂固件通过 ESP32-S3 LCD_CAM/GDMA 驱动 ET047TC1；分别验证 G4/G3 的 A/B 按住和松开。官方 UIFlow2 v2.5.4 启动并绘制界面。

blockers: Factory display reaches PM1 power-enable and reads 4000 mV; independent charging, IRQ and wake-source injection were not exercised.
The factory PM1 shutdown command exits the guest; independent power-key, standby and restart behavior were not validated.
The factory demo reaches the empty-slot SPI path; a mounted image, card-detect transitions and sector transfers were not validated.
